# Model comparison (generated by `compare_models.py`)

All numbers are computed by the pipeline; nothing is hand-entered. Supervised and anomaly models are **not** compared with each other: they solve different tasks.

| ablation: no operational state (booking-time info only)        |                 0.36  |           0.431 |     0.427 |      0.433 |

## Selections (rules fixed before test evaluation)

* Best overall supervised classifier (CV macro-F1): **Logistic Regression** (test macro-F1 0.654)
* Best Critical-class detector (CV Critical recall): **Logistic Regression** (test Critical recall 0.595, precision 0.557)
* Most interpretable: **Logistic Regression** (linear in standardised inputs; coefficients readable directly)
* Best anomaly detector (validation PR-AUC, delayed): **Isolation Forest** (test PR-AUC 0.628)
* For reference, on the test period the highest macro-F1 is Logistic Regression and the highest Critical recall is Logistic Regression.
